reason: B is the stronger proposal because layer-by-layer in-situ remelting is a specific, falsifiable extension of prior surface-remelting evidence to SLM defect control, whereas A largely repeats the cited ~500 °C thermal-management result already demonstrated for CrNbTiZr L-DED. B still requires careful heat-input optimization because remelting can increase distortion, keyholing, or grain coarsening, but that risk is explicitly testable against the conventional-SLM baseline.
